Conjunction: A New Moon natally — your conscious will and instinctive emotional nature are deeply fused, creating powerful focus and consistency. You are what you feel, and you feel what you are.
Trine: This harmonious trine (120°) indicates that these two planetary energies flow together naturally and supportively. The gifts this aspect offers can become so comfortable they're taken for granted — consciously engaging them unlocks their extraordinary potential.
Sextile: A helpful angle (60°) — an opportunity rather than a gift. These two work well together once you actually engage them; unlike a trine, this one waits to be picked up, and rewards you generously when it is.
Square: This square (90°) creates productive tension between these planetary forces. The friction generates energy, motivation, and ultimately, mastery — once the conflict is worked through consciously. Many of history's greatest achievers have chart full of squares.
Opposition: This opposition (180°) represents a polarity requiring integration. You may experience this as an inner tug-of-war, or project one pole onto other people. The path forward is holding both energies simultaneously rather than alternating between them.
